blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: public key — Distributable key in a pair.
private key — Secret member of key pair.
TLS — Protocol establishing secure authenticated channels.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Symmetric encryption uses the same secret key for encryption and decryption. The difficulty is sharing that key securely.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Asymmetric encryption uses a public/private key pair. Public-key encryption for confidentiality uses a recipient's public key to encrypt and their private key to decrypt.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Real secure connections typically use a hybrid protocol: authenticated asymmetric cryptography to establish secrets, then efficient symmetric encryption of application data.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Alice encrypts with the agreed secret K; an observer without K should not recover the plaintext.

blocks.title: Worked example · Show method
blocks.text: Bob uses the same secret K to decrypt, so key secrecy and its secure distribution matter.

questions.feedback: public key — Distributable key in a pair.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: Alice encrypts to Bob's public key without needing to learn Bob's private key.

blocks.title: Show method
blocks.text: Bob retains the private key and decrypts. The public key must be authenticated to prevent substitution.
